subject: The secret setting 95% of users never discover
preview_text: This one hidden toggle changes how the AI sees everything. Most people miss it completely.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. For months, I watched users get good results with the scanner. But the real pros? They were getting scary-accurate, next-level insights. I finally asked one what her secret was. Her answer made me realize I'd built a feature most people never even find.

It's the difference between seeing a red flag and understanding the whole toxic pattern behind it. Beginners scan a text and get a warning. Power users tweak one setting and the AI starts connecting dots across weeks of conversations, spotting the slow-burn manipulation everyone else misses. It's like turning on night vision for your relationships.

Deep in the app settings, there's a toggle called 'Enable Pattern Memory.' It's off by default because it's powerful. Turn it on, and the AI doesn't just analyze single screenshots in isolation anymore. It starts building a private, anonymous timeline of behaviors, so it can warn you about escalation, love-bombing cycles, or guilt-trip patterns you'd never catch on your own.

Open the app right now. Go to Settings > AI Analysis and flip on 'Pattern Memory.' Then scan your most recent conversation. The difference in the breakdown isn't subtle—it's the upgrade that turns a handy tool into your personal protection system. P.S. This is the exact setting the user who caught her partner's gaslighting 3 weeks before the blow-up told me about. She said it was the reason she saw the truth in time.
